metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/` and built successfully with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.

Files:
- [main.py](/workspace/output/main.py)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [src/main.cpp](/workspace/output/src/main.cpp)
- [src/gedcom.cpp](/workspace/output/src/gedcom.cpp)
- [src/json.cpp](/workspace/output/src/json.cpp)
- [src/json.hpp](/workspace/output/src/json.hpp)

What it does:
- `inspect` parses GEDCOM text into the canonical JSON tree.
- `render` turns the canonical tree back into GEDCOM text.
- `inspect_gedzip` decodes a GEDZIP archive, parses `gedcom.ged`, and returns attachments as base64.
- `render_gedzip` creates a GEDZIP archive from the dataset plus attachments.
- Malformed documents and invalid render payloads return structured errors with the requested exit codes.

I also verified:
- basic inspect/render round-trips
- GEDZIP inspect/render round-trips
- malformed input rejection
- pointer payload validation
- empty text payload handling
- root record validation against the spec grammar
